regions.region: page 1 title, authors, bibliographic metadata, and cover illustration
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title. The cover shows the hydrogen-bonded π-stacked poly(quinolylene-2,3-methylene) architecture as a graphical concept; it is linked to the current general-scheme record and is not counted as an independent synthesis.

unresolved: The cover uses generic repeat/R notation and supplies no experiment-specific charge, condition, or yield.

regions.finding: Classified DNA/π-stacked polymer discussion and cited polymers/oligomers as background. The abstract states the present living cyclo-copolymerization class but does not add experiment-specific quantities beyond the Figure 2 runs.

Figure 1a is a generic design strategy, Figure 1b is cited previous poly-1 living cyclo-copolymerization, and Figure 1c is the current hydrogen-bond-stabilized poly-1a concept. Prior and current generic classes are separately classified and are not assigned concrete row yields.

Identified four independent current runs at [1a]/[2]=10, 20, 30, and 50 in CH2Cl2 at 25 °C. All have qualitative quantitative monomer conversion and quantitative poly-1a yield after acetic-acid terminal-Pd removal; no numerical 100% was invented.

unresolved: Absolute charges, solvent volumes, polymerization durations, atmosphere, workup, masses, and quantitative-yield analytical basis are absent.
The online Supporting Information statement does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Figure 2 reaction arrow, Mn/dispersity table, and plot
regions.finding: Recorded each of the four feed-ratio polymerizations separately. Preserved ordered 25 °C polymerization followed by CH3COOH/CH2Cl2 at 25 °C for 1 h, qualitative conversion/yield, and row-specific SEC Mn/Mw/Mn values. The first-stage polymerization time remains missing.

Recorded the poly-1a50 CDCl3/[D6]DMSO 1:1 backbone NMR experiment and the 3/4/5 oligomer NMR conformational comparison. Kept the three reported oligomer preparation claims as separate unresolved records because their actual syntheses are only in unassociated SI; footnote 8's leucine-residue monomer is retained.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Figure 3a-b and adjacent UV/CD discussion
regions.finding: Recorded the poly-1a50/poly-1b50/1' comparison and the n=10/20/30/50 chain-length series with every printed mM concentration and 25 °C condition. Also retained the separately reported concentration-dependence range without estimating Figure S10 points.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Figure 4 and hydrogen-bond/fluorescence discussion
regions.finding: Recorded the 0-50% v/v DMSO UV/CD titration at 25 °C, the 5 mM IR comparison, and the 330-nm-excitation fluorescence comparison as distinct analytical studies. Nonlinear CD response, band positions, emissions, and no-emission comparison retain product/analyte targets.

unresolved: Most spectroscopy acquisition parameters, equilibration times, path lengths, replicate/error data, and SI-only spectra are unavailable.
The concentration-series individual points and oligomer synthetic operations were not inferred.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of Figure 4 interpretation
regions.finding: Linked disappearance of the broad hypochromic signal on DMSO addition to the existing Figure 4 analytical record; no duplicate experiment was created.

Recorded one ordered computational/conformational study spanning MacroModel/OPLS3e search, B3LYP/6-31G** and TD-DFT tetramer work, molecular-mechanics 10-/40-mer construction, and 300 K/1 ns chloroform dynamics. Computed models are mechanisms/model results, not isolated syntheses.

Recorded spin casting of 0.01 mg mL^-1 poly-1a(C18)50 in CHCl3 onto HOPG, annealing at 50 °C for 8 h, AFM imaging, and the 3.6 ± 0.4 nm helical pitch. Spin-casting and annealing are separate ordered steps.
The conclusion summarizes the already-recorded polymer architecture and adds no new reaction arrow or preparation.

unresolved: Detailed computational settings delegated to SI and several AFM preparation/acquisition parameters are unavailable.
Computed distances and structures do not establish experimental isolation or machine structure verification.

regions.finding: Conclusion restates living polymerization, reversible disruption by DMSO, helical structure, and potential applications. It adds no experiment-specific charge, condition, or yield beyond records on pages 2-4.

regions.region: page 5 acknowledgments, conflict, keywords, and references 1-13
regions.finding: Administrative and bibliography/prior-literature content only. Footnote 8 clarifies that the NMR oligomer experiment used a leucine-residue methyl-ester monomer because the alanine analogue partially associated; this evidence enriches the oligomer records but supplies no synthesis procedure.

unresolved: External cited experiments were not re-extracted as current-paper records.
Footnotes referring to Supporting Information do not establish workspace SI association.

regions.finding: Footnote 14 reports the computed poly-1b10' control in which the layered structure becomes disordered; it is merged into the Figure 5 computational record rather than treated as a synthesis or a separate isolated experiment.

regions.region: page 6 references 15-16, manuscript dates, and blank area
regions.finding: Bibliography, publication metadata, and blank page area only. No additional current-paper reaction arrow, procedure, reagent quantity, yield, failure, or characterization mapping occurs.

unresolved: Footnote 14 supplies only the qualitative computed disorder outcome; detailed SI simulation parameters were not imported.
